products.name: Proloquo2Go
products.note: AI: Word prediction. Who: Students with communication needs, SLPs. Student age: App Store age rating 4+; vendor describes it for users aged 2 and up. Privacy: Vendor states usage data is collected anonymously; App Store label lists identifiers and usage data not linked to identity. No school account needed. Price: $249.99 on the App Store; optional Gateway vocabulary $149.99 (May 2026).
